text:
Clara Ruiz: opened a small PR to update the localization availability table and clarify the data-residency note for Private deployments. added ap-sg and ap-in rows and a short migration blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/863

DevDocs Bot: deploy-preview for PR #863 published: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/863 — review requested. :eyes:

Omar Sheikh: quick question: which request header should we recommend in the snippet? `X-Redwood-Region` or the older `Redwood-Region`?

Priya Nair: we standardized on `X-Redwood-Region` for server SDKs. include a tiny note that older clients may still send `Redwood-Region` and show a migration example.

Ben Wallace: agree. suggest a one-line migration note: "If your integration sets `Redwood-Region`, migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` to avoid proxy routing issues." Keep it short.

Clara Ruiz: can someone add micro-examples (curl + python requests) and fix a broken GDPR footnote anchor I found? the footnote anchor changed in a recent legal update.

Priya Nair: pushing snippets now.

```bash
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: ap-sg-1" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
```

```python
# python requests example
import os, requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat',
  headers={
    'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY')}",
    'X-Redwood-Region': 'ap-in-1',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  json={"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}] }
)
print(resp.status_code)
```

Omar Sheikh: i'll update the CSV row and drop an anchor redirect for the GDPR footnote. noted small nit: the Private residency blurb references KMS/HSM; only mention if it's directly tied to residency guarantees.

Ben Wallace: thanks — also flagged a tiny formatting issue where the SDK snippet fence wasn't closed in the mobile preview.

DevDocs Bot: CI passed for PR #863. Preview updated.

Clara Ruiz: merging after a quick sanity check. will add an internal onboarding note linking to the updated region matrix. thanks all! :rocket:
